dedupe_keys.name: a new 3d seismotectonic model of the northern apennines pedeapenninic margin for seismic hazard assessment

description: A new 3D seismotectonic model of the Northern Apennines Pedeapenninic margin for seismic hazard assessment is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Giacomo Carloni et al. Faults have the potential to generate earthquakes causing significant damage to societal infrastructure and life losses. Multidisciplinary methods are used to assess seismic hazard in areas where the study and parametrization of earthquake-generating faults present significant challenges, for example due to the scarcity of fault exposures. Coverage: not stated; published in 2025. Formats: CSV, Excel, Shapefile, Image, ZIP. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 2691744510 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
